description: Generate /etc/hosts file configuration information required for cluster node configuration based on IP information from the Getallnicip tool output

option.name: Hostname (without serial number)
option.help: Prefix named as node, node name: hostname + serial number

option.name: Configure the segment
option.help: Definition of the grid to which the host name refers, e.g.: 10.10.100.0/24

option.name: Node IP Info
option.help: IP information for gettingallnicip tool output

output.name: IP to hostname map
output.help: Map of the public card IP to hostname
